turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly please. Today we are doing subtraction. First sum, fifty two minus twenty seven. Write it in your copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, no, that is wrong. Next, Arjoon, what did you get?
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody say it with me, twenty five.

turns.teacher: Arjun, I told you already. You borrow one ten, so twelve minus seven is five, and four minus two is two. Twelve minus seven, four minus two. Listen properly this time!

turns.teacher: Okay, everyone who got twenty five, thumbs up. Show me your thumbs.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Do it quickly, two minutes only.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, why are you counting on fingers? Don't use fingers, that is why your answer is coming wrong. Put your hands down.
